package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner;

import net.officefloor.plugin.variable.Val;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.repository.OwnerRepository;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto.OwnerFieldsDto;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.escalation.OwnerTelephoneInUseException;

/**
 * Rejects a create request whose telephone is already used by any other owner. Runs
 * after {@link ValidateOwnerFields} has normalized the telephone to E.164, and before
 * {@link BuildOwner}, so a duplicate is a 409 rather than a persisted record. Duplicates
 * are detected by comparing E.164 values.
 */
public class CheckOwnerTelephoneUnique {

    public void service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request, OwnerRepository ownerRepository)
            throws OwnerTelephoneInUseException {
        String telephone = TelephoneE164.toE164(request.getTelephone());
        if (telephone == null) {
            return;
        }
        for (Owner existing : ownerRepository.findAll()) {
            if (telephone.equals(TelephoneE164.toE164(existing.getTelephone()))) {
                throw new OwnerTelephoneInUseException(request.getTelephone());
            }
        }
    }
}

Done. The change rejects creating an owner whose lower-cased email is already used by another owner, responding with 409.

What I added, following the existing telephone-unique pattern:

- **`CheckOwnerEmailUnique`** (`.../function/owner/`) — a pipeline step that reads the validated `OwnerFieldsDto`, and (email being optional) skips when absent; otherwise compares the lower-cased email against every existing owner's email and throws a checked `OwnerEmailInUseException` on a match.
- **`OwnerEmailInUseException`** — checked exception (`extends Exception`) so it surfaces in the `throws` clause for escalation.
- **`OwnerEmailInUseExceptionHandler`** — responds `409 Conflict`.
- **`officefloor/escalation/...OwnerEmailInUseException.yml`** — wires the exception to its handler.
- **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted a `checkEmail` step (under `transaction` governance) between `checkTelephone` and `checkHousehold`, so a duplicate email is a 409 before any record is persisted.

The new `coreRejectsDuplicateEmail` acceptance test and the full suite pass (BUILD SUCCESS).
